description: SAP Agents part 2 (2026-10-18): bright SAP Horizon-style look. 1920x1080 with a left azure-to-violet rail holding stacked SAP / Agents chips and a vertical stepper; near-white canvas with a faint azure dot matrix; teal highlight (not gold); FreeSans + FreeMono; items slide in from the left; scenes change with a vertical wipe and a teal edge; indigo lower-third captions with a teal tick.
